description: This header file declares a function for creating a command handler that loads configuration files into the Cuttlefish Android virtualization environment. It includes includes for command sequence execution, instance management, and command handling, indicating its role in orchestrating Cuttlefish instance loading based on JSON configurations.

methods.name: NewLoadConfigsCommand
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to a CvdCommandHandler responsible for loading and configuring Cuttlefish instances based on input JSON configurations.
